content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Baton Rouge

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Verify your background meets one pathway before enrolling. Granite PM Academy staff can review your qualifications at no cost.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend sessions on your schedule from anywhere, interact with active certified practitioners, and gain the formal education PMI mandates. Your completion certificate unlocks PMP application eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with the Project Management Institute, document your project experience, and pay the PMI exam fee. PMI reviews your background to confirm credential eligibility. Processing typically takes one to two weeks before you receive exam authorization.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and study guides to reinforce course material. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Pass the computerized PMP exam to earn your credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP credential is valid for three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) by attending training, conferences, or volunteering on projects. Renew your PMI membership and submit your PDUs before expiration to keep your certification active.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
